lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments visible. Spacing is uneven, with the widest interval occurring at the mid-section and decreasing in frequency toward the posterior torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One distinct Y-shaped bifurcation observed in the central-lateral region where the fourth line from the anterior splits mid-torso into two descending segments.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 1, 2, and 6 from the anterior terminate before reaching the ventral boundary; line 8 is presented as a shortened segment in the upper dorsal quadrant of the flank.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density grouping of 4-5 high-contrast white spots located on the posterior haunch, superior to the hock joint.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Symmetric lyrate curvature; horns emerge from the frontal bone at a posterior-lateral angle before curving medially and anteriorly at the apices.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 1.5 times the width of the individual horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping is visible on the terminal 12-15% of the total horn structure length.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three Red-billed Oxpeckers (Buphagus erythrorhynchus) on the torso and neck; high-contrast white facial chevron and two distinct white circular spots on the lower mandible/cheek area.
